WITH matched_sales_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_store_sk,
           ss.ss_net_profit,
           sr.sr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4
      AND d1.d_year = 1999
      AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d2.d_year = 1999
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d3.d_year = 1999
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       max(m.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       max(m.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       max(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM matched_sales_returns m
JOIN catalog_sales_filtered cs
  ON m.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
 AND m.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN store s
  ON m.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i
  ON m.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
